about: Events for the timeline game (timeline.html). y = year (negative = BCE), m = month 1-12, d = day; leave out m/d when only the year is known. approx: true marks a rough date (shown as 'בערך') and ties with events a few years either side. Events with only a year tie with any event of the same year, so either order counts as right. f = how well known the event is, 1 (everyone knows it) to 5 (rare); the difficulty level picks events by f.
